title: News & current affairs (B1)
note: Course-doc theme, above leaf_society_a2. Basic news literacy: the headline, the report, who governs. Feeds trunk_opinions_b1 and the second-conditional discussion work. First draft 2026-09-02, rough. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 underlined paraphrases, not CZ→EN of the bank. F7: six tiles an earlier pack already owns were replaced with news lexis that is new here — article→broadcast, daily→coverage, abroad→scandal, agreement→vote, development→issue, peace→campaign. A12: four tiles are the same string in a different sense and are sense-marked instead — party (political), interview (in the news), report (a news story), fall (a drop). Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_news_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: seven rewrite items re-cut so replacing the underline reconstructs the answer. · 2026-09-05 B1 loop: sentence texture. 27 of 36 Use sentences were FLAT or THIN under check_sentence_texture.py — the worst bank at B1 for this fault: a news noun dropped into `The X did Y` with nothing recycled. All 27 rewritten to make one clause move and carry two or more already-taught words. 0/36 fail now. `somebody` was tried in the fire item and swapped for `a neighbour`: it is not taught anywhere before path slot 14. · 2026-09-05 F7/F9: 5 words dropped from the bank and moved onto the You already know page (created) — journalist, government, law, education, disaster. An earlier unit owns them; they stay in this unit's sentences as recycled vocabulary. The first pass on 2026-09-05 did this backwards, stripping such words off the page and leaving them in the bank.

intro.title: You already know
intro.note: These words are not new — earlier units taught them. They come back in this unit's sentences; what is new is everything after this page.
intro.note_cz: Tato slova nejsou nová — naučil ses je dřív. V této lekci se vracejí; nové je všechno, co následuje.

intro.title: You will use these words in

sentences.en: I read the headline but not the article, because I was late for work.
sentences.cz: Přečetl jsem titulek, ale ne článek, protože jsem měl zpoždění do práce.
accepts: I read the headline but not the article, because I was late for work

sentences.en: The government will announce a new law when the summer holidays finish.
sentences.cz: Vláda oznámí nový zákon, až skončí letní prázdniny.
accepts: The government will announce a new law when the summer holidays finish

sentences.en: There is an election next year, but nobody knows who will win.
sentences.cz: Příští rok jsou volby, ale nikdo neví, kdo vyhraje.
accepts: There is an election next year, but nobody knows who will win
There's an election next year, but nobody knows who will win

sentences.en: The economy is stronger than it was when my parents were young.
sentences.cz: Ekonomika je silnější, než byla, když byli moji rodiče mladí.
accepts: The economy is stronger than it was when my parents were young

sentences.en: Thousands of people joined the protest because the prices were too high.
sentences.cz: Tisíce lidí se přidaly k protestu, protože byly ceny příliš vysoké.
accepts: Thousands of people joined the protest because the prices were too high

sentences.en: The report on the accident was two pages long, but nobody read it.
sentences.cz: Zpráva o té nehodě měla dvě strany, ale nikdo si ji nepřečetl.
accepts: The report on the accident was two pages long, but nobody read it

sentences.en: The minister gave an interview after the meeting finished.
sentences.cz: Ministr poskytl rozhovor poté, co schůzka skončila.
accepts: The minister gave an interview after the meeting finished

sentences.en: This channel shows the news every hour, but the films are old.
sentences.cz: Tenhle kanál dává zprávy každou hodinu, ale filmy jsou staré.
accepts: This channel shows the news every hour, but the films are old

sentences.en: The press asked the same question three times because nobody answered it.
sentences.cz: Tisk položil stejnou otázku třikrát, protože na ni nikdo neodpověděl.
accepts: The press asked the same question three times because nobody answered it

sentences.en: The police will investigate the fire because a neighbour saw a man running.
sentences.cz: Policie ten požár vyšetří, protože jeden soused viděl utíkat nějakého muže.
accepts: The police will investigate the fire because a neighbour saw a man running

sentences.en: The editor did not print the story because the photos arrived too late.
sentences.cz: Redaktor ten článek neotiskl, protože fotky dorazily příliš pozdě.
accepts: The editor did not print the story because the photos arrived too late

sentences.en: The station will broadcast the game if the weather stays dry.
sentences.cz: Stanice ten zápas odvysílá, pokud zůstane suché počasí.
accepts: The station will broadcast the game if the weather stays dry

sentences.en: The coverage on the radio was better than anything on television.
sentences.cz: Zpravodajství v rádiu bylo lepší než cokoli v televizi.
accepts: The coverage on the radio was better than anything on television

sentences.en: The scandal cost the minister his job, but his party won again.
sentences.cz: Ten skandál stál ministra místo, ale jeho strana zase vyhrála.
accepts: The scandal cost the minister his job, but his party won again

sentences.en: No politician answered the question when the journalists asked about money.
sentences.cz: Když se novináři zeptali na peníze, žádný politik neodpověděl.
accepts: No politician answered the question when the journalists asked about money

sentences.en: The debate on the radio was longer than the film we wanted to watch.
sentences.cz: Debata v rádiu byla delší než film, který jsme chtěli vidět.
accepts: The debate on the radio was longer than the film we wanted to watch

sentences.en: Her party won the election in every big city, but lost in the villages.
sentences.cz: Její strana vyhrála volby v každém velkém městě, ale na vesnicích prohrála.
accepts: Her party won the election in every big city, but lost in the villages

sentences.en: The poll says half the country wants a change, but nobody believes it.
sentences.cz: Průzkum říká, že polovina země chce změnu, ale nikdo tomu nevěří.
accepts: The poll says half the country wants a change, but nobody believes it

sentences.en: She gave her vote to the youngest candidate.
sentences.cz: Svůj hlas dala nejmladšímu kandidátovi.
accepts: She gave her vote to the youngest candidate

sentences.en: The minister spoke on the news last night because the hospitals are full.
sentences.cz: Ministr včera večer mluvil ve zprávách, protože jsou nemocnice plné.
accepts: The minister spoke on the news last night because the hospitals are full

sentences.en: Workers have rights, but many of them are afraid to ask.
sentences.cz: Zaměstnanci mají práva, ale spousta z nich se bojí zeptat.
accepts: Workers have rights, but many of them are afraid to ask

sentences.en: The company has international offices, but the biggest one is in Prague.
sentences.cz: Ta firma má mezinárodní pobočky, ale ta největší je v Praze.
accepts: The company has international offices, but the biggest one is in Prague

sentences.en: Her campaign cost a lot of money, but she still lost the election.
sentences.cz: Její kampaň stála spoustu peněz, ale volby stejně prohrála.
accepts: Her campaign cost a lot of money, but she still lost the election

sentences.en: The crisis started when the biggest bank closed.
sentences.cz: Krize začala, když zavřela největší banka.
accepts: The crisis started when the biggest bank closed

sentences.en: The tax on petrol went up again because the government needs money.
sentences.cz: Daň z benzinu zase stoupla, protože vláda potřebuje peníze.
accepts: The tax on petrol went up again because the government needs money

sentences.en: The health service needs more doctors, but the pay is too low.
sentences.cz: Zdravotnictví potřebuje víc lékařů, ale platy jsou příliš nízké.
accepts: The health service needs more doctors, but the pay is too low

sentences.en: The conflict between the two families started when a wall was built.
sentences.cz: Konflikt mezi těmi dvěma rodinami začal, když se postavila zeď.
accepts: The conflict between the two families started when a wall was built

sentences.en: There was a rise in prices after the summer.
sentences.cz: Po létě přišel růst cen.
accepts: There was a rise in prices after the summer

sentences.en: The fall in the number of students was bigger than the town expected.
sentences.cz: Pokles počtu studentů byl větší, než město čekalo.
accepts: The fall in the number of students was bigger than the town expected

sentences.en: The reform of the schools will take many years, but it has already started.
sentences.cz: Reforma škol potrvá mnoho let, ale už začala.
accepts: The reform of the schools will take many years, but it has already started

sentences.en: The biggest issue in this election is money, not the health service.
sentences.cz: Největší téma těchhle voleb jsou peníze, ne zdravotnictví.
accepts: The biggest issue in this election is money, not the health service

use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.

use_sentences.prompt: I only read the big words at the top of the page.
use_sentences.underline: big words at the top of the page
accepts: I only read the headline

use_sentences.prompt: The government will tell everyone about the new law.
use_sentences.en: The government will announce the new law.
accepts: The government will announce the new law

use_sentences.prompt: The police will find out what caused the fire.
use_sentences.en: The police will investigate the fire.
accepts: The police will investigate the fire

use_sentences.prompt: The person who decides what the paper prints said no.
use_sentences.underline: person who decides what the paper prints
accepts: The editor said no

use_sentences.prompt: There is a vote for a new government next year.
use_sentences.en: There is an election next year.
accepts: There is an election next year

use_sentences.prompt: The paper did a study of what a thousand people think.
use_sentences.underline: study of what a thousand people think
accepts: The paper did a poll

use_sentences.prompt: The country is in very serious trouble with money.
use_sentences.en: The country is in a crisis with money.
accepts: The country is in a crisis with money

use_sentences.prompt: There was a jump in prices after the summer.
use_sentences.en: There was a rise in prices after the summer.
accepts: There was a rise in prices after the summer

use_sentences.prompt: The government will completely change the schools.
use_sentences.en: The government will reform the schools.
accepts: The government will reform the schools

use_sentences.prompt: Everybody talked for weeks about what the minister did wrong.
use_sentences.en: Everybody talked for weeks about the scandal.
accepts: Everybody talked for weeks about the scandal

use_sentences.prompt: The radio reporting of the election was better than the paper.
use_sentences.en: The radio coverage of the election was better than the paper.
accepts: The radio coverage of the election was better than the paper
